evidence_added: Five-carrier 60m 2026 monthly median abs(slope_t) scale ratios range from about 1.61x to 3.32x.
Strictly causal rolling median-abs normalization with 40/80/120 prior-score windows reduces cross-carrier strength-level dispersion by about 92.7%/94.6%/96.0% on the common evaluation window.
The same normalization does not consistently reduce within-carrier monthly strength drift.
No causal candidate strictly Pareto-dominates V1 across preregistered state-semantic dispersion metrics.
All candidates preserve direction sign; state changes versus V1 are only directional-versus-SIDEWAYS boundary changes.

scientific_interpretation.established: 60m raw slope_t scale is materially time-varying on the 2026 five-carrier independent-source window.
scientific_interpretation.not_established: A rolling causal scale estimator that is simultaneously cross-carrier comparable, temporally stable, and state-semantically non-inferior.
scientific_interpretation.important_separation: Strength-scale normalization and state-boundary normalization must remain separate research questions.

recommended_next_research: If continued, study temporal scale estimators for normalized_strength only, or regime/clock-aware scale decomposition, without changing V1 state boundaries unless a future preregistered candidate achieves semantic non-inferiority.
